jobs.title: Senior Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI
jobs.jd: As a Senior Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the German market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities. You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. The Embedded Approach The Senior Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. What You’ll Do As a Senior Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. Key responsibilities include: Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. What We’re Looking For To succeed in this role, you should bring: Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. Qualifications Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. jobs.jd: Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads. Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience. As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people. We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you! Key job responsibilities The science challenges include: - Heterogeneous customer responses. The same customer responds differently to ads depending on what they’re watching, how engaged they are, and their broader streaming context. We need to understand and predict this variation to make better advertising decisions in real time. - Signal sparsity in streaming. Unlike search or retail advertising, streaming offers no clicks, no conversions, and limited direct feedback. We must develop creative approaches to infer customer preferences, intent, and tolerance from indirect behavioral signals. - Personalization at scale. A one-size-fits-all ad experience leaves value on the table for both customers and the business. We build systems that adapt ad load, placement, and content to individual viewers across 100M+ customers and 100k+ titles. - Small effects, large variance. Ad interventions typically produce 0.1-2% shifts in engagement, effects easily overwhelmed by natural behavioral variance. Measuring, attributing, and optimizing these small signals requires rigorous experimental design and causal methodologies. - Competing objectives. Revenue, customer engagement, long-term retention, and advertiser value are in tension. We develop principled frameworks to navigate these tradeoffs and optimize for sustainable outcomes rather than any single metric. A day in the life - Lead the research and development of ML models that personalize advertising decisions for 100M+ customers across 100k+ titles, with production deployment in mind - Develop deep learning architectures (multi-task learning, embedding-based representations) for customer behavior prediction at scale - Design and analyze large-scale A/B experiments, applying causal inference techniques to measure and optimize the impact of ad strategies on customer engagement and monetization - Partner with engineering to ensure models meet production latency and scalability requirements - Collaborate with product managers to frame business problems as tractable ML problems and translate findings into product decisions - Shape the team’s scientific roadmap, identifying high-impact research directions About the team Prime Video Ads is pioneering the use of Generative AI, Deep Learning and Causal ML to empower the next generation of Ads experience in Prime Video. Our vision is to build the world’s most valuable and differentiated ad-supported streaming platform: one where every ad is relevant to the viewer, and every dollar spent by an advertiser delivers measurable results. We are seeking lead applied scientists who have demonstrated experience in advancing state of the art ML algorithms, particularly in Personalization, Relevance, Casual Inference and Gen-AI areas. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own our customer deployments end to end. Our system runs on-prem at industrial facilities, critical infrastructure, and military sites, integrated with the cameras, networks, and robots already in place. You survey the site, plan the deployment, install and integrate the system, tune it to the site's conditions, and hand it over to operators who will rely on it daily. You are also the technical face of Laelaps on site. You work with security operators to understand how they actually work and where the bottlenecks are, align with their leadership on what success looks like, and translate what you learn into configuration, code, and product priorities. Early deployments you run alongside the founders; over time you own sites and accounts independently. Expect roughly half your time at customer sites in Switzerland and Europe, and the rest in Zurich, turning field lessons into tooling and automation that make each deployment faster than the last. This is an engineering role with a customer in the room, not a support or services role. What You'll Work On Deployments end-to-end: site surveys, network and hardware planning, installation, camera and VMS integration, commissioning, validation, and handover. On-prem infrastructure: install and manage our stack on edge hardware (NVIDIA DGX Spark, Jetson Thor class devices) inside customer networks, often air-gapped or heavily restricted. Integrations: connect existing cameras, sensors, VMS platforms, and robots into one coordinated system, and write the glue code where no integration exists yet. System tuning: calibrate detection and tracking to each site's terrain, lighting, and threat profile until the system performs in the field as it does in the demo. Pilots to production: make POCs succeed technically, because pilots that work become contracts. Customer understanding: sit with operators, interview stakeholders from the control room to the leadership floor, and map the real problems and bottlenecks behind the stated requirements. Customer trust: train operators, respond fast when something breaks, and be the engineer customers ask for by name. The deployment playbook: turn every hard-won lesson into runbooks, tooling, and automation that compound. Product feedback: bring real field signal back to the core engineering team and shape the roadmap with it. Who We're Looking For We are looking for an engineer who runs toward the messy parts, with the EQ to match the IQ. You are as comfortable in a server room or on a windswept perimeter as you are in a terminal, and just as comfortable in a conversation. You can spend a shift with a security operator and earn enough trust that they tell you what actually goes wrong at 3 a.m., then brief a head of security or a site director in their language, not yours. You listen more than you pitch, you read the room, and you switch registers between the guard house and the boardroom without breaking stride. You debug across the whole stack without ceremony: is it the hardware, the network, the driver, the model, or the config? Above all, you take personal ownership of the outcome: the deployment works because you made it work, and the customer trusts us because you earned it. Your Background 3+ years of relevant software, robotics, embedded systems, or systems integration experience. A Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong Python and hands-on C++ experience. You can read, debug, and extend production code in both. Experience deploying and operating software on-prem or at the edge (Docker required; GPU inference experience a strong plus). Experience working with sensors and embedded systems, including device interfaces and communications protocols. High EQ and experience working directly with end users or customers: you can uncover needs, work across stakeholders, and communicate technical issues clearly. Composure in customer-facing technical sessions, including when systems fail and plans need to change. Fluent German and/or French, and good English. Our sites and their operators run in German; the team runs in English. Willingness to travel regularly to customer sites across Switzerland and Europe, with multi-day on-site stints. Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich. Citizenship of Switzerland, an EU/EFTA member state, or a NATO member state, and eligibility for security clearance where customer sites require it. A valid category B driving license. Nice to Have Real networking competence: VLANs, firewalls, routing, VPNs, and debugging connectivity in networks you do not control. Hands-on comfort with hardware: you have racked servers, flashed devices, crimped a cable, or built systems that touch the physical world. Checking cable connections at 2 a.m. at a client site is second nature while debugging an issue on a customer side. Experience with cameras, VMS platforms (Milestone, Genetec, or similar), ONVIF/RTSP, or the physical security industry. Computer vision or ML deployment experience, especially optimising inference on edge GPUs. Robotics experience: ROS2 and Rviz2, robot integration, or fleet operations. Experience in defence, government, or other regulated env

jobs.jd: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. Job Category Software Engineering Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters The Forward Deployed Consultant owns a customer engagement end to end: from the executive business case, through rapid design and deployment of automated process solutions (“Blueprints”) on the Regrello platform, to a clean handoff to partners and client teams. You will advise enterprise leaders, quantify ROI, and map multi-year automation roadmaps. You bring domain depth in supply chain, ERP, or finance operations processes, including where people patch over system gaps. You will also roll up your sleeves to build, test, and iterate Blueprints with AI agents and prompting tools, proving value fast in live production. You are customer-obsessed, strategic, and execution-focused, with the speed and quality to turn fragmented manual workflows into scalable, value-driven solutions. Build business cases and define success criteria up front: KPIs such as cycle time and cost per transaction, with a measured baseline. Own multi-year roadmaps for process Blueprints and automation, balancing strategic direction with near-term execution. Present to executives in terms of their priorities; flag when work is off track early and plainly, with a fix, and drive to a decision. Lead structured discovery (workshops, process maps) and turn it into a solution design and a first working version in days to weeks. Automate business processes end to end (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, supplier onboarding), deciding what stays in the ERP, what is automated around it, and what AI decides versus people. Build hands-on with AI agents and prompting tools: design prompts, structure outputs with schemas and examples, and debug and iterate when they fail. Identify integration points with core systems (REST, event-based), managing risks such as auth, latency, payload limits, and retries. Translate strategic goals into clear PRDs and technical acceptance criteria. Deliver in continuous build loops (design, build, validate, refine), where each loop proves value and expands scope toward AI-first operations. Lead an AI-first delivery experience, using AI agents and skills to accelerate requirements, build, testing, and documentation. Own delivery end to end through go-live: scoping, build, UAT, data migration, and cutover, managing scope change along the way. Cut scope to the highest-value slice(Day 1 Scope/MVP)) when needed to get live, and justify the trade-off to the customer. Design and run handoff processes, documentation, and enablement that transition ownership to implementation partners and customer teams. Set handoff guidelines, solution architecture documentation, and success criteria for sustained post-deployment success. Minimum Requirements 5+ years in Solutions Consulting, Forward Deployed roles, Strategic or Management Consulting, Product Management, Process Automation, or Business Analysis. Domain depth in supply chain, ERP, or finance operations processes (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, AP/AR, supplier onboarding), including where people patch over system gaps. Hands-on experience building AI or agent-based automation yourself, including prompt design, output structuring, and iterating on failures. Experience engaging enterprise executives in B2B SaaS to build business cases and long-term roadmaps. Proven track record owning engagements from discovery through go-live (UAT, data migration, cutover), not just POCs, followed by structured handoffs. Strong grounding in workflow mapping, process modeling, process improvement, and change management. Experience translating business requirements into automated workflows, PRDs, and user stories. Working knowledge of integration patterns (REST, SOAP, event-based) and common risks such as auth, latency, and payload limits. Track record of setting success KPIs and baselines up front and measuring outcomes after go-live. Executive presence: confident with skeptical executives and willing to deliver bad news early, with a plan. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with the Salesforce platform ecosystem (APIs, platform services). Track record building or navigating partner ecosystems and implementation channels. Lean, Six Sigma, or related process improvement certification. Technical or business degree; MBA a plus. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. jobs.title: Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI
jobs.jd: Many companies are deciding right now how AI agents will work with their customers and service teams. These decisions will shape their customer experience for years — and in this role, you help Germany's largest enterprises make them well. As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the German market, you are the senior technical advisor in our most strategic CRM opportunities across Customer Service, Field Service and Sales & Order Management. You lead the solution strategy of large, complex and highly visible accounts together with the Account Executive, earn the trust of C-level stakeholders, and prove value with Agentic AI on the customer's own data rather than on slides. You join a team of CRM specialists from Retail, Telco, Financial Services and Tech who learn a lot from each other — and you help shape how the market sees Agentic AI in CRM. The Embedded Approach The Advisory Solution Consultant wins on proof, not presentation. Demos are minimal and purposeful. The center of gravity is a focused Proof of Value (POV): rigorous Discovery isolates the one problem worth solving, an Agentic workflow is built on a slice of the customer's data, and the outcome becomes a quantified business case for executive decision-makers. What You'll Do As an Advisory Solution Consultant, you lead the technical and value strategy in strategic CRM accounts — using your technical depth, Agentic AI expertise and business acumen to turn proven outcomes into executive decisions, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. Key responsibilities include: Lead the technical and solution strategy of strategic CRM accounts together with the Account Executive, owning customer meetings and account activities that move the opportunity forward. Act as trusted advisor to C-level stakeholders such as CCOs, COOs and Heads of Customer Service. Run rigorous Discovery to isolate the one high-value problem worth solving before any product is shown. Scope and secure a POV with executive sponsorship, then build it hands-on with our Agentic workflow capabilities on the customer's data. Build and refine ROI and business cases that turn POV results into a clear path from one proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. Coordinate Solution Consultants, specialists, value consultants and partners in complex pursuits. Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks and Agentic AI patterns that scale across the team. Represent ServiceNow as a credible voice for Agentic AI in CRM at executive events, customer roundtables and our Munich Innovation Center. What We're Looking For To succeed in this role, you should bring: Strategic Account Leadership: You lead complex enterprise opportunities and earn executive sponsorship for data-driven engagements. Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical experience applying AI and Agentic workflows to real business problems — you have built it, not just presented it. Builder Mindset: A builder's instinct — comfortable getting hands-on with a customer's data and environment to prove value directly. Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment. Business Value: You build business cases and translate technical results into clear value stories for senior stakeholders. CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience across service, field service, sales, lead & opportunity management. Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams spanning Sales, Product, partners and delivery. Qualifications 8+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience for CRM/CX solutions, at a software vendor or a leading consultancy. Demonstrated experience leading complex, strategic enterprise opportunities with C-level stakeholders. Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. Experience building ROI and business cases for enterprise decision-makers. Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with comparable cloud CRM solutions.
